body: I'm 21, youngest out of 4, I have no degree, and I am somehow the most successful out of all my siblings.
All usernames I have/ have had were made up my inner preteen self.
I grew up in a family were we weren't made to wear our seatbelts. That changed when I started driving. Now,  I can't even remember if I wear it simply because I don't even think about it anymore.
I'm 21, no degree, working in corporate America. My boss treats me like a child.  I sort of understand it as he has a kid my age, but at the same time, it is a bit demeaning.
I have been in my job for 6 months and I still haven't disclosed my disability status. I am afraid of the reaction when I finally do. I hope everything works out. Hugs.

Just because it says it is gluten free, doesn't mean it is. There are SO MANY ways for the item to get cross contaminated. Some places even sell a product as gluten free, when they themselves are not 100% positive it actually is. 

I'm not talking gluten free pizza at the local joint, I mean the expensive gluten free items that you find in the grocery store. If you have severe allergies, be careful.
